newRelationTypes.name: associated-with
newRelationTypes.definition: Indicates an organizational, operational, or state attribution link between an actor and a governing body.

newRelationTypes.name: targeted
newRelationTypes.definition: Indicates that a threat actor directed cyber attacks or reconnaissance against a specific entity.

newRelationTypes.name: used-tool
newRelationTypes.definition: Indicates that a threat actor deployed or utilized a specific malware family or software tool during an operation.

newRelationTypes.name: executes
newRelationTypes.definition: Indicates that a script or program launches and executes another tool or executable.

newRelationTypes.name: publicized-activity-of
newRelationTypes.definition: Indicates that an online channel or media outlet specifically publishes reports or claims about operations conducted by a threat actor.
